sentences: Yu Gwansun showed her love for her country with courage.
She was only a teenager when Korea was under Japan's control.
Even though she was young, she believed she could do something with her courage.
On March 1 in 1919, she bravely stood up and joined others to fight against Japan's control over Korea.
She told her friends and neighbors not to give up hope.
Although she faced many challenges, she never gave up.
She was caught for her actions and had a difficult time in prison.
However, even then, she stayed strong and hopeful and continued to inspire people around her.
Her love wasn't loud or forceful but was full of kindness and care.
Yu Gwansun's story teaches us that anyone, even a young person, can show great courage and deep love.
It reminds us to fight for our rights and stay brave during challenging times.

items.statement_ko: 유관순은 용기로 나라에 대한 사랑을 보여 주었다.
items.why_ko: 1번 문장에서 용기로 나라 사랑을 보여 주었다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Yu Gwansun showed her love for her country with courage.
items.statement_en: Yu Gwansun used her courage to show how much she loved her country.

items.statement_ko: 한국이 일본의 지배 아래 있을 때 그녀는 이미 나이가 많은 어른이었다.
items.why_ko: 당시 그녀는 겨우 십 대였다고 나온다.
_evidence_text: She was only a teenager when Korea was under Japan's control.
items.statement_en: When Japan controlled Korea, she was already an old adult.

items.statement_ko: 그녀는 자신이 어리기 때문에 아무것도 할 수 없다고 생각했다.
items.why_ko: 어렸지만 용기로 무언가를 할 수 있다고 믿었다.
_evidence_text: Even though she was young, she believed she could do something with her courage.
items.statement_en: She thought that she could do nothing because she was young.

items.statement_ko: 그녀는 1919년 3월 1일에 용감하게 일어나 다른 사람들과 함께 일본의 지배에 맞서 싸웠다.
_evidence_text: On March 1 in 1919, she bravely stood up and joined others to fight against Japan's control over Korea.
items.statement_en: On March 1, 1919, she bravely joined other people in fighting against Japan's control of Korea.

items.statement_ko: 그녀는 친구들과 이웃들에게 희망을 포기하지 말라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: She told her friends and neighbors not to give up hope.
items.statement_en: She asked her friends and the people near her to keep their hope.

items.statement_ko: 많은 어려움을 겪은 끝에 그녀는 결국 포기하고 말았다.
items.why_ko: 어려움을 겪었어도 결코 포기하지 않았다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Although she faced many challenges, she never gave up.
items.statement_en: After facing many hard times, she finally gave up in the end.

items.statement_ko: 그녀는 자신의 행동 때문에 붙잡혀 감옥에서 힘든 시간을 보냈다.
items.why_ko: 7번 문장에 잡혀서 감옥에서 힘든 시간을 보냈다고 나온다.
_evidence_text: She was caught for her actions and had a difficult time in prison.
items.statement_en: Because of what she did, she was caught and went through a hard time in prison.

items.statement_ko: 감옥에서는 낙담하여 주변 사람들에게 아무런 영향을 주지 못했다.
items.why_ko: 감옥에서도 강하고 희망차게 남아 주변 사람들에게 계속 영감을 주었다.
_evidence_text: However, even then, she stayed strong and hopeful and continued to inspire people around her.
items.statement_en: In prison she lost hope and gave no help or courage to the people around her.

items.statement_ko: 그녀의 사랑은 크게 떠들썩하고 강압적인 것이었다.
items.why_ko: 떠들썩하거나 강압적이지 않고 친절과 배려로 가득했다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Her love wasn't loud or forceful but was full of kindness and care.
items.statement_en: Her love was noisy and forceful rather than kind.

items.statement_ko: 그녀의 이야기는 어린 사람도 큰 용기와 깊은 사랑을 보여 줄 수 있음을 가르쳐 준다.
_evidence_text: Yu Gwansun's story teaches us that anyone, even a young person, can show great courage and deep love.
items.statement_en: Her story shows us that even a young person can have great courage and deep love.

items.statement_ko: 그녀의 이야기는 우리의 권리를 위해 싸우고 힘든 시기에도 용감하라고 일깨워 준다.
_evidence_text: It reminds us to fight for our rights and stay brave during challenging times.
items.statement_en: Her story reminds us to stand up for our rights and to be brave when times are hard.
